controlled_benchmark.scope: Local generated-byte fixture; not a YouTube or ISP speed measurement

regressions: existing prefix not discarded when server ignores Range
malformed Content-Range or total rejected without append
changed source overlap rejected without append
truncated response retries do not duplicate source bytes
short200 error body rejected with and without Content-Length
unknown-size direct formats retain native resume
supervised launcher imports actual bundled engine
supervisor cancellation reaps child and grandchild
cancellation during short-write append preserves a valid contiguous prefix

live_smoke.follow_up_comparison: YouTube sign-in/bot verification blocked extraction; stopped probing
live_smoke.conclusion: Live YouTube transfer acceleration was not validated in this shared environment
